name: Crowley Miami Distribution Center - Medley FL
type: Distribution center / LCL liner & logistics warehouse

fieldNotes.facility: Crowley Miami Distribution Center, 10205 NW 108th Ave, Medley FL 33178 (Miami-Dade). ROOFTOP geocode landed at 25.8656,-80.3725; the building is the long warehouse running NNW-SSE with its dock face and container yard on the EAST side, in the Beacon Lakes / Doral-Medley industrial park. POSITIVELY IDENTIFIED as Crowley: a navy CROWLEY intermodal container and a red CROWLEY trailer are parked at the gate, with CROWLEY signage on the building (Street View 2025-10). Per Crowley press release the Medley DC is ~180,000 sq ft (consolidated Medley + Doral ops) with double the prior receiving doors, 5,000+ pallet positions, and 95 container parking spots.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE. The single truck entrance is at the NORTH end where the access road meets the property. Street View (2025-10) shows a GREEN chain-link sliding/rolling security gate spanning the full truck drive, with continuous chain-link perimeter fencing on both sides and concrete jersey barriers flanking the entrance. A STOP sign sits at the road. Clearly a controlled, gated entry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE. No staffed guard booth is visible at the gate in Street View or in zoom-20 satellite -- just the sliding gate panels, fence, and barriers. No 1-3-vehicle-footprint booth beside the lane.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: TRUE. There IS a truck gate but NO guard shack, implying access by card/kiosk/app at the sliding gate.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: TRUE. One gated entrance serves both in and out (single sliding gate at the north drive).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 1 inbound / 1 outbound through the single sliding gate; not separately marked (flagged uncertain).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: TRUE. A deep paved container court sits inside the gate before the docks; trucks can stage and queue there.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: TRUE. The gate-to-dock approach runs the length of the container court and can hold 3+ trucks; ample internal stacking.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band. The east face is a near-continuous dock line along a ~230 m (~768 ft) building with containers/trailers backed in; estimated ~58 doors (dockDoorCount is an overhead estimate, flagged uncertain).
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+. The east container yard holds dense rows of parked intermodal containers and trailers (red/blue/white steamship boxes, incl. MAERSK and CROWLEY units) -- a large dedicated drop/storage lot; Crowley spec = 95 container parking spots.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE. A dedicated, fenced container/trailer storage yard runs the full east side of the property, separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ~95 container slots per Crowley's published spec for this DC; consistent with the dense yard rows in imagery.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~70 containers/trailers counted across the dock face + yard in zoom-19/20 imagery (estimate, flagged uncertain).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: FALSE. All docks are on a single (east) building face; shipping and receiving share one dock cluster.
fieldNotes.scale: FALSE. No truck scale / weigh pad visible in the truck path.
fieldNotes.railServed: FALSE. No rail spur enters the property. The large rail-served intermodal complex visible ~1 km NW is a separate facility, not this DC.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: FALSE. Single warehouse building on the parcel.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban. Medley/Doral is a dense industrial municipality inside the Miami metro.
fieldNotes.confidence: High for facility identification (Crowley branding confirmed on container + trailer + building) and for the gate / no-guard-shack / remote-gate determination (clear 2025-10 Street View of the sliding gate). Dock-door and trailer counts are honest overhead estimates and are flagged uncertain; lane counts inferred.
